verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-mention-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous loans from the NWTF institution are associated with increased funding speed.

female-currency-php-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the loan amount in local currency (PHP) fund faster.
female-currency-php-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the loan amount in Philippine Pesos are associated with increased funding speed.

female-general-store-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention running a general store business may fund more slowly.

hardship-detail-faster-general.body: Mentioning specific living or family hardships may accelerate funding regardless of gender.

male-trade-history-faster.body: Male borrowers who describe a lifelong history with their trade may fund faster.

male-loan-count-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention a specific number of previous loans may fund slower.

female-productivity-health-faster.body: Female borrowers who prioritize productivity or health improvements over household assets or family consumption may fund faster.

female-technical-financial-details-slowe.body: Female borrowers who provide specific financial or institutional details like monthly income or collateral rules may fund more slowly.

female-bulk-inventory-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific bulk products or inventory quantities may fund faster.

female-technical-supplies-slower.body: Female borrowers who list specific technical supplies like fishnets or certified seeds may fund more slowly.

female-family-community-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who include descriptive details about family members or community impact may fund more slowly.

female-children-count-faster-puzzle.body: Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund faster.

female-age-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund faster.
female-age-mention-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower pitches mention specific age.

female-nwtf-mention-faster-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who mention NWTF as a previous lender may fund faster.
female-nwtf-mention-faster-puzzle.retrospective: Retired as duplicate of existing claim female-nwtf-mention-faster.

female-children-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund faster.
female-children-count-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific child counts appear in slower pitches.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.
female-savings-goal-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-age-children-slower.

female-age-children-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their age or number of children fund more slowly.
female-age-children-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that age and marital status were present in faster pitches.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that thanking lenders correlates with faster funding.

female-family-status-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention family status or specific children may fund more slowly.
female-family-status-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by new observations that age and child count appear in faster pitches.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly address or thank the lenders may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower Indonesian loans include explicit gratitude.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.title: Pitches from women that use the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' are associated with decreased funding speed.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-currency-php-faster.

female-age-mention-faster-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who mention their specific age in the pitch may fund faster.
female-age-mention-faster-puzzle.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower pitches mention borrower's age.
